page.title: History Artifacts: Documented Origins Since 2015
page.summary: An artifact-anchored timeline of JVTO's continuity — same address, same founder, same operation — from the 2015 guesthouse era to today.

lede: Continuity you can observe, not just claims: the same address, the same founder, and the same operation, documented from the 2015 guesthouse era through PT formalization to today.

blocks.body_md:
- **2015 — Booking.com Guest Review Award.** Score 9.4/10, independently calculated by Booking.com. Issued to the guesthouse at Jl. Khairil Anwar 102A, Bondowoso. Physical plaque and award letter retained on-site.
- **Guesthouse era — Stefan Loose Travel Guide, first mention.** The earliest European travel-guide editorial citation naming the founder as operator for Ijen crater tours — pre-digital corroboration from an independent editorial source. Publication year and edition are not asserted.
- **2021 — Detik.com press article.** "Suka Duka Polisi Pariwisata Bondowoso" — national-reach press coverage identifying the founder (Bripka Agung Sambuko) in his Tourist Police role, independently confirming the police-led model. [Read article on Detik.com](https://news.detik.com/berita-jawa-timur/d-5492690/suka-duka-polisi-pariwisata-bondowoso-tegakkan-prokes-sambil-lawan-dingin)
- **2023 — PT Java Volcano Rendezvous formalized.** NIB 1102230032918 registered via OSS Indonesia; TDUP tourism licence issued 2023-02-11 by the Ministry of Tourism. All registrations publicly verifiable. [Verify PT on the AHU registry](/verify-jvto/legal)
- **Today — Active licensed operator.** PT Java Volcano Rendezvous operates under NIB + TDUP No. 1102230032918, HPWKI-certified guides, a registered ISIC provider listing (Provider ID 259268), and an INDECON network listing. Led by an active Tourist Police officer. [See full credential verification](/verify-jvto/legal)

---

**Same address. Same founder. Same operation.**

The Booking.com award (2015), the Stefan Loose travel-guide mention (guesthouse era), the Detik.com press article (2021), and the PT registration (2023) all reference the same location — Jl. Khairil Anwar 102A, Bondowoso — and the same person, Agung Sambuko. Continuity is observable, not just claimed.

items.question: Why treat artifacts as part of trust?
items.answer: Because continuity is verifiable where marketing is not. A physical Booking.com plaque from 2015, an editorial guidebook citation, a national press article, and a government PT registration all point to the same address and the same founder — an evidence trail a traveller can cross-check, not a claim they have to take on faith.

items.question: Does JVTO assert a specific incorporation year?
items.answer: No. JVTO's brand and operation date from 2015 (the guesthouse era), and the PT was formalized in 2023 — evidenced by the TDUP tourism licence issued 2023-02-11 and NIB 1102230032918. JVTO does not assert a separate PT incorporation date, because no authoritative incorporation document supports one.
